# FreeCAD LAP SDK — LLM Reference Guide

Compressed API reference for the FreeCAD Python API.
Use these .lap files to write FreeCAD scripts, macros, and workbench add-ons.

## Quick Start

Fetch the base reference (always start here, ~12K tokens):
https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-base.lap

This contains the object navigation graph, common gotchas, and core types
(Document, Vector, Placement, Rotation, etc.).

## Domain Files

Fetch the relevant domain file based on the task:

- Part shapes, primitives, booleans, OCCT wrappers:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-part.lap

- PartDesign: Body, Pad, Pocket, Revolution, Fillet, etc.:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-partdesign.lap

- Sketcher: SketchObject, geometry, constraints:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-sketcher.lap

- Draft 2D drawing, convenience functions:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-draft.lap

- TechDraw: drawing views, dimensions, annotations:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-techdraw.lap

- Path (CAM) toolpaths, operations:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-path.lap

- Mesh operations:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-mesh.lap

- FEM: finite element analysis:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-fem.lap

- Assembly constraints:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-assembly.lap

- FreeCADGui: ViewProviders, Selection, Commands:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-gui.lap

- Uncategorized classes and enums:
  https://halletj.github.io/freecad-lap-sdk/lap/freecad-misc.lap

## Rules for FreeCAD Scripts

- Always import: import FreeCAD as App; import Part
- Units are always millimeters internally
- ALWAYS call doc.recompute() after modifying objects
- Create objects via doc.addObject('TypeString', 'Name')
- Features must be added to a Body via body.newObject()
- Use the [graph] section in freecad-base.lap to navigate the FreeCAD object model
- Sketch geometry uses Part types: Part.LineSegment, Part.Circle, etc.
- Constraints reference geometry by 0-based index

## Format

Files use .lap format: classes with ":" for inheritance, properties without parens,
methods with parens, *collection<T> for collection classes. The format is plain text
and self-describing.

## Source

Repository: https://github.com/halletj/freecad-lap-sdk
Generated from FreeCAD Python API stubs + FreeCAD wiki documentation.
